bio.text: Gary Winfield, a Democrat from New Haven, was sworn in to the Connecticut State Senate on February 28, 2014, and is serving his fifth term as Chief Deputy Majority Leader.
Before the Senate, he served three terms in the Connecticut House of Representatives.
He is originally from the Bronx and graduated from Southern Connecticut State University in 2006 with a bachelor's degree in political science.
He lives in New Haven with his wife and four children.
